entries.condition: why the declared catalogue calls a host value every Windows host's, asked of an analysis row, of a Sigma selection's value and of a path of the file's text: a key or value every installation has, a service's key or a settings subkey exactly one level below it, a path made only of drives, names Windows gives its own folders and a profile name, a file Windows ships in its folder, Windows' own name, and the sample as the sandbox holds it
basis: the value and its vocabulary kind
the sample's digests and submitted name

entries.condition: the refusal of a registry key exactly one level below the key of a service the catalogue lists, named as the catalogue's service_settings_subkeys, on every route that asks the catalogue

the refusal of a path every component of which the catalogue reads by its name (a drive, a known folder's or system folder's name, an environment or 8.3 form, a known-folder constant, the profile name right after the users folder under a drive or first in a path written without one), on every route that asks the catalogue
basis: the catalogue's known_folders, environment_folders, system_folders, system_roots and known_folder_prefixes

entries.condition: why the rule refuses a host value the analysis states, printed in the identifier table, the analyst report and the full export list: the first of its checks that fails, a value no cited entry holds whole said by what the scan that wrote held_in found (with the count read and the count cited where the row cites more than are read), and a stored row without that finding by what its record holds
basis: the row's kind, use and value
held_in and unheld_as, written by stated_host_values.scan_cited

entries.condition: the refusal of a stated host value no cited entry holds whole where the scan found it in a cited entry: whole only where the entry's answer repeats what its call asked for (and, where the rest of the answer shows it, elsewhere only inside a longer run of text), only as bytes the entry's text writes, only inside a longer run of letters or digits, only between spaces, or somewhere not counted as the whole value
the refusal of a stated host value whose text none of the cited entries holds in any spelling, every cited entry read
basis: held_in empty and unheld_as nowhere, written by stated_host_values.scan_cited
the count of distinct entries the row cites, at most MAX_CITED

entries.condition: the refusal of a stated host value whose text none of the cited entries read holds in any spelling, where the row cites more entries than the check reads: the count read and the count cited
basis: held_in empty and unheld_as nowhere, written by stated_host_values.scan_cited
the count of distinct entries the row cites, above MAX_CITED

entries.condition: after the words of what the scan found in the cited entries read, where the row cites more entries than the check reads: the count read and the count cited
basis: the count of distinct entries the row cites, above MAX_CITED

entries.condition: the refusal of a stated host value whose row records held_in empty and no word of what the scan found (a report stored before the scan recorded it): what its record holds, never that no cited entry holds the value
